finalText:
**Redis died and took prod down.**

```
02:14:07  Redis refused connections at 10.0.0.12:6379
02:29:12  request queue passed its 500 limit
02:31:44  worker-2 ran out of memory
02:31:52  api killed, service down
```

All times are July 4 UTC, not last night. The cache vanished. Every read hit the store instead. It could not keep up. All 13 reconnect tries failed.
